name: Wolpertinger
description: A mythical hybrid creature of southern Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg: a small mammal — typically a rabbit or hare — fitted with antlers, fangs, wings, and other animal parts, popularised through 19th- and 20th-century 'gaff' taxidermy mounts displayed in inns and museums.

aliases.name: Jackalope
aliases.region: United States (Wyoming and the American West)

origin: Folkloric range is the alpine and pre-alpine forests of southern Germany, particularly Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg, with extensions into the broader Alpine region.
